test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is True, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some questions are answers.

All answers are paragraphs.

Some paragraphs are essay.

**Conclusions:**

1. Some questions are essay.

2. Some questions are paragraphs.
solution:
The possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84f553637578b9553e24d880e5e82c92c2f0cebd5ea2322c556617fb6ebffb19.png] 

Conclusions:

1. Some questions are essay → Does not follow (As some questions are answers, all answers are paragraphs and some paragraphs are essay. So it is possible but not definite.)

2. Some questions are paragraphs → Follow (As some questions are answers and all answers are paragraphs. As whole answers comes in paragraphs and has some part common with questions, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion 2 follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
